newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds must crack 109-08 for more upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds must crack 109-08 for more upside.

text.p: June T-bonds must make a concerted break above the 109-08 level on Tuesday if they are to see further gains to 110-00, technical analysts said.
Failure to do so would leave the contract floundering and vulnerable to a fall to new lows below 107-31.
"If we can make any progress above 109-08 and close above it, there's the chance of a bounce back again towards levels above 110-00," said Adrian Sells, director at Crane Investment Analysis.
By 1030 GMT, the June T-bond was at 109-08 in automated trade, up 9/32 from the prior Chicago finish.
"This 109-08 level is absolutely critical," said Sells. "If the market fails from here, the pressure will still be on the market...and it could test new lows beyond the 107.31 made on March 20."
Analysts said initial support would kick in around 108-30, followed by a prop at 108-20,18.
"I would give the bear side the benefit of the doubt today and try a little short position," said Sells.
Analysts said much would depend on the outcome of the Federal Market Open Committee meeting, expected around 1915 GMT.
"The key will clearly be today's FOMC meeting which could give medium to long term directional clues," said American Express Bank senior technical analyst Gerry Celaya in a note.
"On the charts, the bond really does need to recover nearby resistance levels to look better while the 108-00 zone support continues to mark the long-term sell off level."
Celaya said the June T-bond should be set up for a move towards 109-22, then 110-14/16.
Elli Gifford, director at Investment Research of Cambridge, said the June T-bond would bump into small patches of resistance up to 109-16. She put support for the contract at 108-00.
